Validate thermal-index estimates against an hourly station record

Source: R/validation.R
validate_station.Rd

Computes "observed" indices directly from hourly observations and compares them with the estimates thermify produces from progressively less information:

Usage

validate_station(
  station,
  latitude,
  indices = c("gdd", "ch", "cu", "cp"),
  base = 10,
  upper = NULL,
  cutoff = "horizontal",
  gdd_methods = c("average", "single_sine", "single_triangle", "double_sine",
    "double_triangle"),
  hourly_methods = c("linvill", "sine"),
  ch_lower = 0,
  ch_upper = 7.2,
  chill_period = c("05-01", "08-31"),
  heat_period = c("09-01", "04-30"),
  gridded = NULL,
  temporal = c("native", "auto", "tempify")
)

Arguments

station

An object from prepare_station_hourly().

latitude

Station latitude in decimal degrees (Linvill model).

indices

Any of "gdd", "ch", "cu", "cp".

base, upper, cutoff

GDD thresholds and cutoff (see degree_days()).

gdd_methods

Daily GDD methods to evaluate.

hourly_methods

Hourly reconstructions to evaluate: "linvill" and/or "sine".

ch_lower, ch_upper

Chilling interval (degrees C).

chill_period, heat_period

Accumulation windows (see thermify()).

gridded

Optional list with numeric vectors tmin and tmax of length 12 (monthly climatology at the station location).

temporal

Densification engine for the monthly levels.

Value

An object of class "thermify_validation": a list with seasons (one row per season, index, level and method, with estimate and observed), metrics (one row per index, level and method, from validation_metrics()), excluded (seasons not evaluated and why) and quality (from the station object).

Details

  • level "daily": daily extremes of the same station, with the analytical daily methods (GDD, chilling hours) and with hourly reconstructions (Linvill, sine) for chilling hours, Utah units and chill portions. This isolates the error of the diurnal model.

  • level "monthly": the station's own monthly climatology (mean daily extremes per calendar month over all valid days), densified with pchip_mp. This adds the loss of day-to-day variability and of interannual variability: one climatological value is compared with each season.

  • level "gridded" (optional): a monthly climatology from a gridded product, for example the WorldClim cell containing the station. This adds the spatial interpolation error and the difference between climate normal periods.

Only complete seasons are evaluated: a season is excluded when any of its days is invalid after gap filling (see prepare_station_hourly()) or when the record does not cover the whole window. Excluded seasons are reported.

See also

prepare_station_hourly(), validation_metrics(), vignette("validation").
